questions.text: A train running at 72 km/h crosses a 180m platform in 18 seconds. Find the length of the train.
questions.modelAnswer: Speed = 72 * (5/18) = 20 m/s. Total distance = 20 * 18 = 360m. Train length = 360 - 180 = 180 meters.

questions.text: 12 workers finish a task in 15 days. How many workers complete it in 10 days?
questions.modelAnswer: Total work = 12 * 15 = 180 man-days. Workers needed = 180 / 10 = 18 workers.

Explain OOPs concepts in Java with real-world examples.
questions.modelAnswer: OOPs: Encapsulation (data hiding), Abstraction (showing functionality), Inheritance (code reuse), Polymorphism (overloading/overriding).

questions.text: Write a SQL query to find 2nd highest salary from Employee table.
questions.modelAnswer: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employee);

questions.text: Explain the difference between Primary Key, Unique Key, and Foreign Key in relational databases.
questions.modelAnswer: Primary Key: uniquely identifies row, non-null, 1 per table. Unique Key: enforces uniqueness, permits 1 NULL value. Foreign Key: references PK of another table.

questions.text: What is the difference between Process and Thread?
questions.modelAnswer: Process: independent execution unit with isolated virtual memory space. Thread: lightweight execution segment within a process sharing heap memory and file descriptors.

questions.text: Explain REST vs GraphQL API architecture trade-offs.
questions.modelAnswer: REST relies on fixed HTTP endpoints (over-fetching/under-fetching data). GraphQL allows clients to request exact JSON schema shapes in a single query endpoint.

questions.text: Describe a situation where you had a tight deadline and how you prioritized deliverables.
questions.modelAnswer: Use STAR framework. Explain how you prioritized core MVP requirements, communicated with lead/stakeholders early, and delivered on schedule.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you resolved a technical conflict within your project team.
questions.modelAnswer: Focus on active listening, creating an objective pros/cons comparison, running proof-of-concept benchmarks, and aligning on team goals.

questions.text: Tell me about yourself and why you want to work at Cognizant (GenC / Elevate).

questions.text: Where do you see yourself in 3-5 years?
